sediment: Top-down native pixel-art material source for GenVo shoreline sediment. A flat square swatch of damp fine silt with shallow irregular erosion threads, broad quiet compacted mud planes and a few subtle embedded grain clusters. Viewed vertically from above, no perspective. Muted earthy olive-brown and grey-green, low contrast, chunky carefully placed pixel clusters which stay readable after nearest sampling into four 32x32 quadrants. Texture extends seamlessly to all edges without vignette or border; varied fine rills travel in different directions across the square so each quadrant differs naturally. Surface material only: absolutely no water puddles, reflections, foam, grass, reeds, leaves, stones projecting above the surface, food, plants, animals, holes, cracks suggesting impassable terrain, icons or text. No scene, no horizon, no shadows from external objects. Opaque image. Cohesive restrained 2D pixel-game ground texture, designed to be composited inside an existing narrow physical bank mask, not a landscape illustration.
